subsystem.name: RuntimeObjectManagement
subsystem.responsibility: Reconstruction of shared runtime-object services in the generic_runtime_objects scope: session and display-state setters, driver-assist input dispatch, session/config sub-struct lifecycle, settings and player-name setup, path normalization and directory enumeration, vehicle-setup file registration/load, car-selection grid-camera state machine, vehicle dynamics and control-config initialization, and rigid-body transform update.

summary: Twenty-one heterogeneous runtime-object helpers operating across the session tick, display, config, path and physics-init paths. DriverAssistInputHandler (0x0042C440) is the per-frame assist dispatcher: while the session guard at dword_7C54E8+13000 and byte_7CE254 are clear it walks the 16-bit action-code array (dword_7CB218 entries at word_7CB21C) and shifts assist config-pattern buffers through AIShiftPattern, then conditionally dispatches session-transition, visual-state, brake-bias, assist-toggle and vibration behaviors from one-shot command flags. Display state is handled by FormationLapDisplayState (0x0042D140) and PauseStateDisplayToggle (0x0042D210), both resolving strings through the game string table into the shared message buffer byte_5EC4CC. Session lifecycle helpers include SessionReset (0x0042D350), the six-dword SmallDataStructInit (0x0042DC60), ScoreSlotDeallocator (0x0042DDD0) and the penalty sub-struct PenaltyStructInit (0x0042E400). Config/path/file helpers cover validated string copy (0x0042F140), player-name setup (0x004326E0), directory enumeration (0x00432980), auto-load config writing (0x00432BF0), path directory extraction (0x00432DF0, 0x00433290), named-node list removal (0x00433D60), vehicle-setup registration and flag-preserving load (0x00433FC0, 0x00434000). updateCarSelectionStateMachine (0x00434460) with its fallback initializer (0x00434820) drive the pre-race grid-camera phase machine, and the vehicle-side initializers DynamicsObjectInitialization (0x00438C10), BrakeBiasSetup (0x00438CC0) and RigidBodyPositionAndOrientationUpdate (0x0043E6A0) set up dynamics/control state. Ownership is largely unknown; the class groupings are GUESS-level architectural proposals except RigidBodyTransformUpdate which the packet names.

function_roles.role: Per-frame driver-assist input dispatcher: guards on the session guard (dword_7C54E8+13000) and byte_7CE254, walks the 16-bit action-code array, dispatches AIShiftPattern calls for each assist, then session transition, visual state change, brake bias, assist toggle and vehicle vibration from one-shot command flags.

Formation-lap / pit-timer display state setter: stores the new state at this+0xC on change, runs a session-accumulator comparison for states greater than 2, and on server sessions renders the 'Begin Formation' string and drives the per-vehicle loop.
Pause-state flag setter: stores the pause state at this+0x10; on unpause it looks up the 'Paused' string, copies it into the message buffer and triggers the screen update.
Session teardown helper: destroys the texture surfaces of the dword_8AD254 object and delegates the season parent path dword_5EC3D0 through the teardown helper with a zero flag.
Six-dword sub-struct constructor: zeroes four dwords, seeds 30/42 defaults and returns this for chaining; called only from SessionStructInit.
Four-slot score/config buffer deallocator: saves and frees the this+0x4 and this+0xC buffers when non-null and zeroes all four slots.
Penalty sub-structure initializer of the session object: writes an offset float (293.16f) and flag byte, then a 4-iteration repeating pattern of floats and flags into array fields.
Validated string copy: looks up a2 in the owner string table and copies it into (or clears) the this+0xC buffer, returning the destination buffer.

Startup player-name/settings setup: reads the settings setup file, copies setup files, resolves the settings folder path, searches the string table for the player name and walks the per-driver list to enumerate the first matching driver's file.
Directory path normalizer and file enumerator: defaults the path, appends a trailing backslash when missing and enumerates the directory's files.
Writes a fixed six-format-string auto-load configuration entry into a caller-owned buffer with length checks, returning 0 on success.

Path directory extraction: computes a derived string, copies it through the owning-buffer copy, truncates the first path string at its last backslash and routes the directory-only path through the path-processing table slot.
Directory-path extraction and extension comparison: fetches the module directory path, copies it into the output buffer, strips a trailing extension and optionally concatenates a dot-extension.
Removes every node of an intrusive list whose name matches a2, repairing head/tail/count bookkeeping, destroying owned data and freeing the node; clears the object's own stored name on match.
Registration/release helper: writes the caller-supplied path into the global buffer byte_7C56C0; on write failure records the path into this+8 when the flag is set and returns a success indicator.
Vehicle-setup file load that preserves the global flag byte byte_7C56C0 around the load and restores it afterwards; returns the load result.

Pre-race car-selection / grid-camera state machine: init, countdown, wait, advance and end-countdown phases, vehicle-slot scan of the active-vehicle pointer array, pit-exit triggering, and a camera block feeding session-object parameters.

Module initialization with fallback: initializes constraint-solver parameters, stores a virtual dispatch result, runs the primary init and on failure drives the game action state machine and sets the fallback flag.
Vehicle dynamics state initializer: zeroes the main struct, runs sub-component initializers, initializes four per-wheel 6-dword state blocks and finishes wheel dynamics setup.

Per-object control configuration initializer: copies eleven assist-config bytes from the global settings block, derives the control-mode selector, applies bitmask and cross-field fix-ups and stores the scaled driver factor.

Rigid-body position/orientation update: applies a caller-supplied delta vector, extracts Euler angles via atan2 (with a gimbal-lock branch) and applies the transform under an FPU control-word save/restore.

classes.name: DriverAssistController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame driver-assist input dispatcher. Reads the action-code array and one-shot command flag globals and shifts assist config-pattern buffers through AIShiftPattern; drives session-transition, visual-state, brake-bias, assist-toggle and vehicle-vibration behaviors on the session object at dword_7C54E8.

classes.name: RaceMessageDisplay
classes.responsibility: Display-state and pause-message handling on a session display object: sets display/pause state fields, resolves display strings through the game string table and renders them into the shared message buffer byte_5EC4CC.

classes.name: CarSelectionCameraStateMachine
classes.responsibility: Pre-race car-selection / grid-camera phase machine and its fallback-capable initializer. Tracks an init flag, phase dword, two timers, a vehicle-slot counter, a grid-scan index and a camera/session object pointer; advances the slot through the active-vehicle array and drives the camera block.

classes.name: PlayerProfileManager
classes.responsibility: Startup settings/player-name setup: reads and copies setup files, resolves the settings folder, validates the player name against the string table and walks the per-driver linked list to locate and enumerate the matching driver's file.

classes.name: VehicleControlConfig
classes.responsibility: Per-object vehicle control configuration derived from the global assist settings block: copies the eleven assist-config bytes, derives a control-mode selector, applies bitmask and cross-field fix-ups and stores the scaled driver factor.

classes.name: VehicleDynamicsState
classes.responsibility: Vehicle dynamics state initializer: zeroes the main struct, runs the sub-component initializers and initializes the four per-wheel 6-dword state blocks before wheel dynamics setup.

classes.name: RigidBodyTransformUpdate
classes.responsibility: Rigid-body world-position/orientation update: applies a delta vector to the stored position, extracts Euler angles from the orientation matrix via atan2 (including a gimbal-lock branch) and applies the transform under an FPU control-word save/restore.

classes.name: NamedNodeList
classes.responsibility: Intrusive linked list keyed by node name: removal by name unlinks the node, repairs head/tail/count bookkeeping, destroys owned data and frees the node; the object's own stored name is cleared on match.

classes.name: SessionSubStructBuilder
classes.responsibility: Session sub-struct initializers: builds the six-dword small struct (zeroed dwords plus 30/42 defaults) and the penalty sub-structure (offset float/flag plus the 4-iteration float/flag pattern); both are invoked from SessionStructInit.

classes.name: SessionShutdown
classes.responsibility: Session teardown: destroys the texture surfaces of the global state-flag-pair object and delegates the season parent path through the teardown helper.

classes.name: ScoreSlotBufferOwner
classes.responsibility: Owner of a four-slot score/configuration buffer record: deallocates the two optional buffers and zeroes all four slots.

classes.name: ValidatedStringBufferOwner
classes.responsibility: Holds a string buffer at this+0xC that is only written after the source string validates against the owner's string table; the buffer pointer is returned on every path.

classes.name: DirectoryPathEnumerator
classes.responsibility: Directory enumeration helper: reads a directory path from the path array at offset 0x8, defaults it to the application directory, normalizes the trailing backslash and enumerates the directory's files.

classes.name: AutoLoadConfigWriter
classes.responsibility: Writes a fixed six-format-string auto-load configuration entry into a caller-owned write buffer with length checks.

classes.name: PathDirectoryNormalizer
classes.responsibility: Path directory extraction: copies a derived string into an owning buffer, truncates the first path string at its last backslash and routes the directory-only path through the path-processing table slot.

classes.name: PathDirectoryExtractor
classes.responsibility: Directory-path extraction and extension comparison: fetches the module directory path into the output buffer, strips a trailing file extension and optionally concatenates a dot-extension.

classes.name: VehicleSetupRegistration
classes.responsibility: Registration/release helper for vehicle-setup paths: writes the caller path into the shared flag buffer and, on write failure, records the path into this+8 when flagged.

classes.name: VehicleSetupFileLoader
classes.responsibility: Vehicle-setup file load that preserves the global flag byte around the load and restores it afterwards; returns the load result.

state_machines.name: CarSelectionGridCamera
transitions: 3/4->advance: score gate + state flag, slot counter+1, scan of dword_7C54F0, IteratorCheck/PitExit
advance->5: slot counter reaches grid bound, countdown=3.0

state_machines.name: FormationLapDisplay
transitions: state change only when the new value differs
new state>2: run ArithmeticComparison_2e20 on dword_8ACEE0
state 3 (server session, pit timer visible): render 'Begin Formation' into byte_5EC4CC
states 0/2/3/4: per-vehicle loop sub_4C6B60(0) over dword_5C329C

state_machines.name: PauseDisplayToggle
transitions: paused->unpaused: resolve 'Paused' via string table, copy into byte_5EC4CC, trigger update via ShortComputation_bde0

interfaces.name: GameStringTableLookup
interfaces.purpose: Sorted string-table binary search used to validate and resolve display strings (aBeginFormation, aPaused, player name) against the table buffer byte_5EC4C0 into the message buffer byte_5EC4CC.

interfaces.name: OwningStringCopy
interfaces.purpose: Buffer-reallocating string copy, compare and concatenate helpers used across config, path and setup code (copy, compare predicate, append, bounded copy).

interfaces.name: PathNormalizationService
interfaces.purpose: Path normalization and directory enumeration: path-buffer init, trailing-backslash append and directory-only truncation, plus directory file enumeration.

interfaces.name: AssistPatternService
interfaces.purpose: Pattern shifting of driver-assist configuration values. Consumers pass the assist config-pattern buffer and its config key string; eleven assist kinds share the service.

interfaces.name: FreeWrapperService
interfaces.purpose: Generic buffer/slot deallocation used by the score-slot deallocator and the named-node list removal path.

interfaces.name: VehicleSetupFileService
interfaces.purpose: Vehicle-setup file load/write through a shared flag byte byte_7C56C0; both the registration helper and the flag-preserving loader route through it.

interfaces.name: MessageRenderService
interfaces.purpose: Render/update of the shared message display buffer byte_5EC4CC after display-state or pause changes.

interfaces.name: ConfigBufferWriter
interfaces.purpose: Length-checked format-string writes into caller-owned config write buffers (auto-load config entry composition).

compatibility_contracts.name: AssistPatternDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: While the session guard (dword_7C54E8+13000) and input flag byte_7CE254 are both clear, the per-frame dispatcher must walk the 16-bit action-code array (dword_7CB218 entries at word_7CB21C) and shift the corresponding assist config-pattern buffer through AIShiftPattern. A replacement must preserve the config key strings (0x005C33A8..0x005C3480) and the pattern ids used for the steering/opposite-lock/braking-point/stability/spin-recovery/invulnerability/auto-shift/traction/ABS/pit-lane/clutch assists.

compatibility_contracts.name: MessageDisplayBufferContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Display-state and pause changes resolve strings via the game string table (byte_5EC4C0/byte_5EC4CC) and render through TextLineWrappingAndRendering / ShortComputation_bde0. The 'Begin Formation' message must render only in server sessions (dword_7C569C==5) with the pit-timer visible (byte_7CEC78).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSetupFlagPreservationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle-setup loads route through VehicleSetupFileWriter with the shared flag byte byte_7C56C0; the flag-preserving loader must save and restore that byte around the load so the global flag state is unchanged.

compatibility_contracts.name: CarSelectionCameraContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Pre-race car selection advances a vehicle-slot counter, scans the active vehicle-pointer array dword_7C54F0 against the grid-size bound dword_5C329C, triggers IteratorCheck/PitExit per slot, and finishes in a camera block that feeds session-object fields into the steering-interpolation camera and the angle setters.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringTableValidatedCopyContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Callers that copy a string into an owned buffer after a string-table lookup must copy only when the lookup succeeds and clear the buffer when the source is null; the destination buffer pointer is returned on every path.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionResetContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Session teardown must destroy the texture surfaces of the dword_8AD254 state-flag-pair object and delegate the season parent path dword_5EC3D0 through the teardown helper with a zero flag, returning the helper's result.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverListWalkContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Player-name setup must walk the per-driver list rooted at *(this+0x20) with bound *(this+0x2C), advancing through node +4 next pointers and reading each node's name at +0x0, and enumerate the matching driver's file when the name comparison matches.

unresolved: AIShiftPattern pattern-id semantics and the meaning of each dword_7CExxx assist config-pattern buffer are defined by the callee and unknown here.
The session-structure fields at dword_7C54E8 + 13000 and + 13004 have unknown meaning beyond the guard and session-transition roles.
Meaning of the one-shot command flag globals (0x7CC260, 0x7CC394, 0x7CC3C0, 0x7CC3EC, 0x7CC6D8, 0x7CC704) is assumed to be set elsewhere in the input system.
dbl_7C7428 as a vehicle-object reference for VehicleActive is presumed from the call shape, not confirmed.

Common ownership of the display-state field (this+0xC) and pause-state field (this+0x10) by a single RaceMessageDisplay object is an architectural assumption; the packet does not prove both methods share one receiver.

The penalty sub-struct offsets this+0x1CB8..0x1CF4 and the six-dword small struct this+0x0..0x14 are grouped under SessionSubStructBuilder because both are called from SessionStructInit (0x0042E320); the full session layout is unknown.
States 3 and 4 of the car-selection machine both fall through to the score-gate advance block; the semantic difference between sub_4D8760's first arguments (0 vs 2) is not established.

Read-only globals 0x0059E440, 0x0059E65C and 0x005EA618 (car-selection), and 0x0059EB98 and 0x007CE498 (brake-bias) are recorded by the packet but do not appear in the raw decompiled text; their role is unplaced.
Globals 0x005C3F88..0x005C3F98 and byte_5EA438 are listed in the packet for WriteAutoLoadEntry but not referenced by the decompiled body.
The literals 3 (render mode) and 16909060 (color/value) in the TextLineWrappingAndRendering call have no confirmed semantics.
The meaning of the 30/42 default literals in SmallDataStructInit and the 293.16f/359.86f literals in PenaltyStructInit is unknown.
sub_568910's behavior and sub_587DD0's exact append semantics (whether a3-1 is respected as a bound) are not provable from this packet.
The backslash-scan loop in PathDirectoryExtractionAndComparison computes a cursor that is never consumed; likely dead code or a decompiler artifact.
byte_7C56C0's flag bits and why the flag-preserving loader must restore it around vehicle-setup loads are unknown.
The meaning of the string field at this+8 in the registration helper (released/registered path) is not packet-evidenced.
The 512 constant and the EmptyStub_7780 diversion on FPU control-word mismatch in RigidBodyPositionAndOrientationUpdate are FPU-state hygiene whose game-specific intent is unknown.
dword_7CD204 is referenced by static facts for 0x0042D140 and 0x0042D210 but does not appear in the raw bodies; role unknown.
